title: Photo backup and sync across devices (iCloud Photos style)
summary: Back up a large photo library reliably in the background, sync edits and deletions across devices, and save device space by keeping thumbnails locally and full resolution in the cloud.
requirements: Upload new photos/videos automatically (Wi-Fi by default), resumable, without draining battery.
Library of 50k+ items browsable instantly on every device; full-res downloaded on demand.
Sync favorites, edits (non-destructive), albums and deletes (with 30-day recently deleted).
Privacy: encryption in transit and at rest; optional end-to-end (Advanced Data Protection).
components: PhotoKit change observer (`PHPhotoLibraryChangeObserver`, persistent change tokens) to detect new and changed assets
Upload queue (persistent) with chunked, resumable uploads via background URLSession
Content hashing (SHA-256) for dedup: skip upload if the server already has the blob
Metadata sync engine (cursor-based, like offline-first sync) separate from blob transfer
Server: metadata DB + object storage + CDN; derivative generation (thumbnails, video transcodes)
Local cache: thumbnails always, full-res LRU with 'optimize storage' eviction
tradeoffs: Separating metadata from blobs lets the library appear instantly while blobs upload slowly.
Client-side derivative generation saves server CPU and enables E2EE, but costs device battery; server-side is cheaper for the device but needs plaintext.
Edits stored as adjustment data (recipe) instead of new full images save space and allow revert, but every client must render them.
Uploading only on Wi-Fi and power protects users' data plans and battery but delays backup; expose the choice.
body: **Upload pipeline:** detect asset → export original to a file (background task) → hash → `POST /uploads` with hash (server says 'have it' or returns chunk URLs) → upload 8MB chunks with background URLSession → commit (server assembles, creates derivatives) → mark synced.

**Background execution:** background URLSession continues transfers when suspended; `BGProcessingTask` (requires power) for exporting and hashing large batches; iOS 26 `BGContinuedProcessingTask` for user-initiated bulk exports.
**Download path:** grid shows thumbnails from local cache; tapping fetches a screen-size rendition first, then full-res if the user zooms or edits.
**Conflicts:** edits are versioned per asset; concurrent edits on two devices → last-writer-wins on the edit recipe with the other kept as a version, or ask the user.
**Deletes:** tombstones synced to all devices; hard delete after 30 days.
**Metrics:** backup completeness (% of library synced), time to first backup after capture, upload failure reasons, bytes over cellular.

code.caption: Upload state machine
code.text:
discovered -> exporting -> hashing -> negotiating
    negotiating --(server has blob)--> committing
    negotiating --(needs upload)--> uploading(chunk i/n) -> committing
committing -> synced
any state --(retryable error)--> waiting(backoff) -> previous state
any state --(asset deleted locally)--> cancelled
